title: Locale selector · dropdown
description: Pill button with chevron-down + current language label on desktop. On mobile it compacts to a two-letter locale code and code-only dropdown. Hydrates from /core/api/language/active.json on a real server; falls back to en/fr/es when offline (file:// or no API).

params.description: Default trigger label before JS hydration. After hydration, JS replaces it with the active locale name.
API endpoint to fetch available locales. JS expects an array of {code, name} or {items: […]} payload.
Locale list used when the API is unreachable (file:// preview, offline, server error). Edit as raw JSON in CMS.
Mobile presentation uses two-letter language codes in the trigger and dropdown.

notes: Block JS is idempotent — running it twice on the same node is a no-op (uses dataset.localeInit guard).
Outside-click closes the dropdown. Esc also closes.
Active locale persists in the ?locale= query param (history.replaceState — no navigation).
Mobile breakpoint is <=600px. Harness includes a forced .locale-selector--mobile preview so the compact version is visible in desktop review.
